sources.title: Current four-PDF build lineage
sources.license_allowed_use: Project-authored layout and build script; embedded figures, scenes, text, data, and fonts retain their respective rights and license disclosures.
sources.spatial_coverage: Formal A3 and A0 submission presentation
sources.temporal_coverage: Rebuilt on 2026-08-30 from the final 23 bilingual figure pairs
sources.generation_method: The deterministic N2d build continues the approved N2b S1-to-S2 chain. The N2d S1 layout builder reads the 23 Chinese and 23 English final figures and their proposal captions, builds page SVGs, converts them with rsvg-convert, and embeds local JPEG streams produced with Pillow. The N2d S2 pass re-embeds same-language byte-identical JPEG payloads with the carried-forward N2b profiles (2000-pixel q70 evidence cover; 750-pixel q82 standard figures; 1100-pixel q82 readability samples; 700-pixel q82 4:2:0 triptychs), strips image metadata, and Flate-compresses page content streams with pypdf. The A3 pair has 25 pages each and the A0 pair has 4 pages each; both language pairs preserve the same 23-figure order. The first-page site-overview is measured at about 162 ppi on A3 and 55 ppi on A0; remaining embedded figures measure 136-215 ppi on A3 and 91-143 ppi on A0.
sources.transformation: All four PDFs were replaced only after page count, paper size, 23-caption sequence, bilingual alignment, English visible-CJK, 58/58 Flate page-content streams, same-language A0/A3 image-payload parity, Source Han font-family, first-page quantitative layout gates, and original-size human visual checks passed. First-page gates passed for right-column width, figure area, full-page ink, body-text height, and tight text-box whitespace; no cropping, overlap, missing text, or deformation was found. drawings/a0-boards.pdf: SHA-256 5a14130ec568a780c6c951aea9e75a59ac8cef1610c885768b01e072cce0b6b2; drawings/a0-boards.en.pdf: SHA-256 0117acb4b8be1b1a3563d45c382ee2084fb935b9d29ac5840975bf284ed8c0b8; drawings/a3-booklet.pdf: SHA-256 18d35d8ae9f2e7c538a1a37a0013553995468a2ed63ea61fc6717cd3f220650d; drawings/a3-booklet.en.pdf: SHA-256 8306d300dfe399bd46b764f7678a21cddb6b27482828b9390b00b6097920f9e6
